source.title: Characterizing Desorbed Surface Contaminants Leading to Plasma Formation in Power Feeds of Pulsed Power Accelerators
source.page_text:
Figure 4.28: Allegra simulations at 40 ns into the current pulse of Mykonos shot 17133. The
images show the current, magnetic field across the gap, current density in the cathode, and
temperature in the cathode. The lineouts of each of the profiles shown are taken at either
the foil-edge location or the foil-middle location, as represented by Fig. 4.27, right panel.
[Simulation data courtesy of Alex Sarracino, Derek Lamppa, and Kyle Cochrane from Sandia
National Laboratories.]

source.hash_validation: PDF, page content and decoded RGB mandatory; lossless PNG encoding may vary

simulation_context.observation_type: reconstructed published legacy simulation drive inset
simulation_context.source_display_clock: literal Time [ns] axis in the published simulation inset

unit_interpretation.value_role: literal plotted axis coordinates; not a validated original simulation input

selection.rule: one contiguous exact RGB run of 2–8 pixels within the vertical ROI; single-pixel caps and absent/ambiguous columns excluded
selection.left_clip_qualification: curve reaches the first native interior column; its beginning outside the displayed frame is unknown
selection.right_support_qualification: finite visible snapshot trace; final retained column is not a recovered pulse tail or an inserted snapshot endpoint

readout_bounds.time_recipe: native column +/-2 pixels, mapped by fitted time axis and expanded by maximum absolute time tick-fit residual
readout_bounds.current_recipe: entire matched run [first_y,last_y], extended by +/-2 pixels, mapped by fitted current axis and expanded by maximum absolute current tick-fit residual

limits: Published legacy Allegra simulation raster; distinct from the measured Figure C.19 shot-current trace.
The displayed time origin, trigger relation and experimental clock registration are unknown; negative plotted times are retained.
Caption snapshot times label the figures and do not determine an observed waveform tail or justify endpoint padding.
The left trace is display-clipped; no missing beginning, zero crossing, pulse onset or continuation is reconstructed.
Literal ns/MA conversions preserve plotted coordinates; original simulation input arrays and normalization remain unavailable.
Samples and full-run/readout envelopes are correlated raster observations, not independent experimental noise.
No current renormalization, time fit, VUV gate, magnetic/current closure, physical heating input or FLASH result is inferred.
